episode_row: Fly shadow instance posted picks publicly as a 2nd bot

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): wire shadow_mode into all Bluesky posting paths
commits.body:
CRITICAL FIX: shadow_mode config was set but never read by the
scheduler. The Fly machine was posting to Bluesky as a second
production instance. This wraps all 3 post_to_bluesky call sites
(normal lock, fallback deadline, final fallback) in shadow_mode
checks. When shadow=true, picks are saved locally but never posted.
